# Bundled browser runtimes

- p5.js 1.11.3: https://github.com/processing/p5.js (LGPL-2.1).
- Original expression-enabled ml5 teaching build: https://github.com/ml5js/Intro-ML-Arts-IMA/tree/ml5-build-10-7-19/ml5_build (ml5.js MIT; bundled dependency notices remain in the script).

The same scripts previously loaded from jsDelivr. Local copies avoid external download failures during a workshop. The expression model weights are unchanged and bundled separately in p5-expression/models with the upstream face-api.js license.
